limitations.detail: Many supplied private-newsletter claims could not be corroborated for the specific round. A completed disposition is not completed factual verification. Details remain in both filled financing CSVs.

Only 451 of 901 eligible in-sample digital reference mentions map to counted equity episodes. Unmatched references include genuine gaps, instrument/scope holds, proxy timing and unresolved issuer names; they are not all verified missing deals.
293 of 581 historical in-sample candidate references map to the stricter H01 equity view. Old broader financing capture cannot be reused as current equity capture.

101 of 145 fixed test rows count in their requested period; 9 match a different source period. The test includes potentially ineligible instruments and list proxy dates. Targeted repairs mean it is no longer untouched.
Normalized name collisions include both possible aliases and genuine homonyms. Every remaining group is listed; unsupported merges were avoided.

All six digital source families were searched, but successfully extracted mentions are concentrated in AlleyWatch. China/India/Europe coverage is not demonstrated comprehensive; source search failures and unparsed lists remain visible.
The equal-depth acquirer sweep is finite. Unverified candidate/group claims are excluded. Undisclosed prices and source-unstated valuation basis remain unknown.

Retained raw and historical projections include original assertions. The current count/amount tables are authoritative for this audit; a public-source URL alone is not verification of every historical valuation field.
